text:
Type: curly sheepskin rug
Use: softening a chair seat, bench or bedside floor; living room, bedroom, reading nook
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, minimalist
Materials: natural sheepskin with short tight curly wool
Colors: light cool grey, silver
Shape: organic hide outline with rounded lobes, dense curly fleece, small and soft, light visual weight
Feel: cozy, soft, warm, natural
Goes with: light wood chairs, white walls, wool and linen textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or cabin rooms
